claims.text: DFT-based simulations can determine whether ferromagnetic ground states are present.
The proposed method applies to ferromagnetic materials at low temperatures.
Electronic structure is the structural mediator connecting DFT simulations to identification of the magnetic ground state.
DFT accurately models the electronic structure of ferromagnetic materials.
Modeling electronic structure allows ferromagnetic ground states to be identified.
The method predicts the presence or absence of a ferromagnetic ground state.
DFT-based simulations have limitations when modeling complex magnetic systems.
Limitations of DFT-based simulations create uncertainty in identifying ferromagnetic ground states.

contradictions.description: The initial state labels the target materials as ferromagnetic, whereas the baseline is given as non-ferromagnetic ground states, without explaining whether the baseline is a separate comparator or an alternative state of the same materials.
